init.title: UPS sync settings

data.load_idle_max: UPS output (W) at or below which the servers are certainly off
data.notify_services: Notify services, comma separated (for example notify.mobile_app_phone)
data.t_ob: On battery this long before shutdown starts
data.t_grace: Wait after the last server goes quiet before cutting
data.t_dead: Wait before cutting when servers went off on their own
data.t_wake: Wait before powering on a server that is off while another is up
data.t_hold: Input stable this long before restore
data.t_off: Keep the group off at least this long before restore
data.t_wait: Alarm if shutdown takes longer than this
